steps.title: Cream the sugar and butter
steps.body: Cream together **1 cup sugar**, **½ cup butter**, softened, and **2 eggs**, beaten.

steps.title: Add the cornmeal
steps.body: Add and stir in: **1 cup corn meal**, **½ tsp salt** and **2 tsp baking powder**.

steps.title: Add the flour and milk
steps.body: Add, alternating: **1½ cups flour** and **1½ cups milk**.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Place in a greased 10×12 pan and bake for 23–30 minutes at 375°F.
